changes: First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on core-ar2 0.3. Keeps sample loops in time with the project tempo by repitching them: AUTO reads each loop's tempo from its length, SMP locks and scenes included; a percentage correction per sample slot; trailing digital silence left out; the pitch glides on tempo changes.

Limits: pitch follows tempo, with no time-stretch. This exact build (LS18) is tested in the emulator only; the author tested earlier builds on a unit by ear. Persistence across saves and reboots, external MIDI clock and CPU on a unit are not tested yet.
